items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive for Sunday vs DET as details finalized.
items.why: Trade being finalized; team informed player morning of game.
items.implication: Immediate zero for fantasy; opens targets in ARI offense short-term and long-term destination unknown.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining ARI pass-catchers

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Week 5.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share to backups like Will Shipley or others

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Week 5.
items.why: Ankle; confirmed on final board and coach comments.
items.implication: Ravens QB zero; backup starts, Flowers/Andrews/Likely usage shifts.
items.opportunity: Increased checkdowns/RZ looks to TEs and Zay Flowers if active

items.text: Broncos placed WR Pat Bryant on IR; promoted Lil’Jordan Humphrey.
items.implication: DEN WR depth thins; others elevate.
items.opportunity: Targets to Courtland Sutton, RJ Harvey receiving, etc.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN for Week 5.
items.why: Ankle maintenance but cleared final report; full-go comments.

items.text: Stefon Diggs listed OUT for Week 5.
items.opportunity: Increased share to Terry McLaurin (if active), Deebo, others

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT for Week 5.
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps to Braelon Allen or handcuffs

items.text: Quentin Johnston listed OUT for Week 5.
items.why: Chest; Schefter confirmed Chargers ruled out.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets boost for Ladd McConkey if active

items.text: Jayden Daniels listed IN for Week 5.
items.implication: WAS offense unlocks; full dual-threat back.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; gut says much better role this week despite ankle maintenance after Week 4 usage criticism. Accounts for downside but expects upgrade.
items.why: Not on final IR; fan/media pressure on prior usage; full-go quotes.
items.implication: Strong RB start/flex with clear lead over committee.
items.opportunity: Expanded carries, snaps, goal-line vs soft DET run D

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; gobbles targets/points, pushes 'Brown Gobbler' nickname.
items.why: Workload + Bengals injury context (Chase/Higgins Q) + MIA matchup.

items.text: Chris Olave listed IN for Week 5.

Fears multi-risk for Malik Nabers long-term: knee becoming real issue, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy at QB, coaching staff boomer tendencies; frustration over low post-halftime targets noted.
items.why: Sore knee missed practice + prior shoulder + target frustration + scheme/QB concerns.
items.implication: Caution on ROS ceiling despite elite talent; monitor status closely.
items.conflict: Usage still high when healthy but stacking risks

items.text: Loves Nico Collins vs TEN as WR8; strong volume and matchup.
items.why: Target hog + Titans secondary struggles + red-zone looks.
items.opportunity: High targets/routes vs weak pass D
